gate_type: REGRESSION BASELINE GATE — Platform vNext Regression Baseline (G8)
objective: Create one canonical, repo-native vNext regression entrypoint plus a machine-readable baseline manifest/contract describing the accepted G1-G7 regression groups, add only the smallest genuinely-missing cross-gate invariant tests (workspace/structural/run-control/UI-hierarchy alignment), and produce G8 regression evidence proving the accepted G1-G7 platform invariants remain green from the exact G7 accepted base lineage (3f8c9409cac5698399ab4d386506b0419d68a5df). No semantics change, no feature, no new runtime mechanism, no G9/G10.
explicit_non_objectives: No change to ASSY/continuous domain semantics
No cross-workspace data exchange / supply-chain semantics
No new invented canonical hierarchy beyond accepted TIPA and continuous/PROCESS
No test-logic duplication (the manifest references existing authoritative tests/commands)

Change ASSY or continuous domain behavior
Invent new canonical hierarchy beyond accepted TIPA and continuous/PROCESS
Duplicate test logic (manifest must reference existing tests)
Run a new third-party test framework
stop_conditions: Completing the regression baseline would require changing any accepted G1-G7 architecture/semantics
Completing the baseline would require selecting a new workspace/runtime ownership model
Completing the baseline would require changing lifecycle/run identity rules
Completing the baseline would require changing coordinator synchronization semantics
Completing the baseline would require changing ASSY or continuous domain behavior

Completing the baseline would require introducing G9/G10 scope
